description: Rajanganaya Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare that Roads owned by Rajanganaya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters, specifically the declaration and registration of roads to be controlled by the Local Council. It includes a detailed schedule of road coordinates, names, distances, and widths, which falls under the definition of land registrations and property ownership matters for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
